Log HRT doses, view plasma levels, and stay on top of your routine. Get started Important information Featherline is a logging tool and does not provide medical advice. Plasma concentration values are model estimates calculated from your dosing schedule, not measured values, and should not replace lab tests or guidance from your clinician. Data & privacy All medication, dose, and lab data is stored in an encrypted local database on your device. The app uses no analytics or third-party tracking services. By default, your data does not leave your device — you can export an encrypted backup at any time. Estimates & modeling Plasma concentration estimates are calculated using approximate pharmacokinetic models based on published data and route-specific assumptions. Individual response can vary significantly. Treat estimates as rough trend indicators only. Not medical advice Information shown by this app is educational and is not medical advice. It cannot diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any condition. Always consult a qualified clinician before changing your regimen. Reminders Dose reminders depend on your device\'s notification and alarm permissions. Battery optimizations or system limits may delay or skip reminders.
